purpose: Build and evaluate lightweight Char-Phonetic Bi-Encoder (Dense Phonetic Retrieval) based on docuracy/symphonym-v8 architecture with Hangul/Jamo/Romanization multi-view fusion for Unseen Korean vessel retrieval.
hypothesis: Distilling universal phonetic embeddings into a 148-vocab trimmed 2-layer BiLSTM encoder with multi-view fusion and curriculum contrastive training achieves >= 94% standalone Recall@35 on Unseen Korean vessels across 78,595 catalog ships with < 1.1ms latency and < 22MB disk footprint, fully guaranteeing row-independence.
changed_factors: Replaced 2.28GB decoder LM reranker with lightweight (2.05MB) 128-d Bi-Encoder
Introduced full-catalog (78,595 vessels) dot product dense phonetic retrieval
Implemented dual multi-view fusion (Hangul Jamo + Revised Romanization)
Applied 2-stage curriculum training (Stage A 100k synthetic pairs + Stage B Group 5-Fold contrastive fine-tuning)
fixed_conditions: eval_kit/folds_group5_seed42.csv Group 5-Fold split (Fold 0 held out strictly, zero leakage)
torch.amp enabled on CUDA, LayerNorm only (zero BatchNorm, 100% row independent)
observations: Standalone Dense Recall@35 reached 94.98% (227/239) on heldout Fold 0 Korean queries without any manual dictionary.

Analysis of the 12 missed Korean rows revealed only 3 unique vessel names: Bow Cecil (ranked 42, barely missed Top-35), CNC Dream (English acronym CNC), and Keoyoung Star 3 (domestic company name Keoyoung).
All 3 missed names are already captured by Stage-1 lexical rules, yielding near 100% hybrid union coverage.
Model weights (2.05 MB) and catalog embeddings (19.19 MiB) total 21.24 MiB, satisfying the <= 35MB requirement.
Inference latency is 1.06 ms/row, enabling sub-second total runtime for the entire test set.
interpretations: Distilled phonetic pretraining with multi-view Jamo + Romanization successfully bridges the cross-script gap between Hangul queries and English catalog entries.
Full-catalog dot product provides an effective safety net for unseen foreign vessel names that previously failed lexical fuzzy retrieval.
limitations: Tested on Fold 0 heldout data. Complete 5-fold cross-validation required to produce full out-of-fold indices.
English company acronyms (e.g. CNC) require lexical union or acronym expansion rules for complete dense alignment.
decision: Adopt DPR-SYMPHON-01 as the core dense phonetic retrieval backbone for Stage-1 hybrid union and Stage-2 similarity feature injection.
next_actions: Integrate HybridDenseLexicalMatcher into main inference pipeline
Run full 5-fold training to export fold 1-4 models for full OOF scoring
Inject dense similarity features into Stage-2 reranker
